quotes.quote: Pooled data from DAPA HF, EMPEROR‐Preserved, EMPEROR‐Reduced, and SOLOIST‐WHF ( n = 15 864)
sub‐groups of patients with LVEF ≤40% ( n = 9199, HR: 0.74, 95% CI: 0.68, 0.81, I 2 : 0%
an SGLT2 inhibitor, specifically dapagliflozin or empagliflozin, added to recommended therapy.

scope.reading: Pandey 2022 pools four trials; the two in our drug scope, DAPA-HF and EMPEROR-Reduced, are both ours (8,474 participants, every one of them in our pool). Its LVEF <=40% subgroup has 9,199, so the excess of 725 comes from its other trials -- SOLOIST-WHF (sotagliflozin, outside our protocol's dapagliflozin-or-empagliflozin scope) and EMPEROR-Preserved (an LVEF >40% trial) -- and is not evidence missing from our pool.
scope.reported_by: external review of the sglt2-hfref-hosp-cvdeath topic (28 Sep 2026)

method_difference.heading: A checkpoint, not a benchmark

quotes.quote: sub‐groups of patients with LVEF ≤40% ( n = 9199, HR: 0.74, 95% CI: 0.68, 0.81, I 2 : 0%

method_difference.reading: Its HFrEF hazard ratio 0.74 (0.68-0.81) pools our two trials with a trial outside our drug scope; agreement with our 0.75 is a checkpoint on largely the same trials, not an independent result, and a difference would not show an error in ours.
